source.title: 2026 Fantasy football deep sleepers: Projections say Tyler Shough and Tre Tucker are steals
source.author: Heath Cummings
source.summary: Projection-backed and conditional late-round values, all carrying CBS ADPs outside the top 150 or no ADP.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Shough's 2025 starting pace, projected touchdown growth, and eventual access to a healthy receiving group create QB1 upside at a QB21 price.
takeaways.rationale: Shough's 2025 starting pace, projected touchdown growth, and eventual access to a healthy receiving group create QB1 upside at a QB21 price.
risks: Early-season receiving health can cap the ceiling.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Coker projects as a top-32 receiver and can benefit from more slot usage after already producing efficiently on limited opportunity.
takeaways.rationale: Coker projects as a top-32 receiver and can benefit from more slot usage after already producing efficiently on limited opportunity.
risks: Carolina still has a developing target hierarchy.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Willis' rushing production gives him a strong chance to beat QB23 pricing even if Miami remains a weak offense.
takeaways.rationale: Willis' rushing production gives him a strong chance to beat QB23 pricing even if Miami remains a weak offense.
risks: Passing volume and offensive quality may limit weekly consistency.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Schultz projects near the TE1 boundary on another 100-plus targets and has top-eight upside with better touchdown luck.
takeaways.rationale: Schultz projects near the TE1 boundary on another 100-plus targets and has top-eight upside with better touchdown luck.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Tucker has emerged as the Raiders' lead receiver and projects to beat his price substantially even before giving him a full coordinator-WR1 target share.
takeaways.rationale: Tucker has emerged as the Raiders' lead receiver and projects to beat his price substantially even before giving him a full coordinator-WR1 target share.
risks: Brock Bowers remains the passing game's central target and the offense may be weak.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Coleman would project for roughly 15 touches per game behind a strong line if J.K. Dobbins misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Coleman would project for roughly 15 touches per game behind a strong line if J.K. Dobbins misses time.
risks: His useful role depends heavily on a Dobbins absence.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Mitchell's extreme efficiency and possible receiving role give him a path to weekly value without fully displacing Omarion Hampton.
takeaways.rationale: Mitchell's extreme efficiency and possible receiving role give him a path to weekly value without fully displacing Omarion Hampton.
risks: The case extrapolates from very low career volume.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Allen can remain a high-volume PPR flex at a near-free price if he continues earning targets in Indianapolis.
takeaways.rationale: Allen can remain a high-volume PPR flex at a near-free price if he continues earning targets in Indianapolis.
risks: Age and competition from younger Colts receivers can reduce his role.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: A fully recovered Bell could be Miami's most talented receiver and a final-round source of size, speed, and late-season upside.
takeaways.rationale: A fully recovered Bell could be Miami's most talented receiver and a final-round source of size, speed, and late-season upside.
risks: His ACL recovery and actual starting role remain uncertain.
